auditScope: image-analysis and voice/realtime-audio models only, Anthropic + OpenAI + Google Gemini

statusLegend.DOCUMENTED: stated directly in official provider documentation
statusLegend.OBSERVED: community/SDK-reported behavior, not stated in official prose
statusLegend.INFERRED: derived logically from documented rules, not stated verbatim
statusLegend.UNKNOWN: not established in this research pass; requires a live API probe

providers.sourceFetchStatus: UNKNOWN — not independently re-fetched this session (domain not in this session's network allowlist); data taken from the reviewed baseline file, which cites the same URL

imageTokenAccounting.antiDoubleChargeRule: input_tokens already includes image tokens; never add a separate image-token estimate on top of the returned input_tokens value

imageAnalysis.pricingUnit: per token, folded into standard input rate; no distinct image SKU

voice.reason: no audio content type exists in the Messages API

imageModels.defaultDetailBehavior: auto/omitted == original (full resolution, no forced downscale) — CHANGED from gpt-4o-era models where auto/omitted == high
imageModels.tokenization: patch-based, 32x32px patches; original detail uses uncapped patch count on this family

imageTokenAccounting.separateBreakdownField: UNKNOWN — not confirmed whether Responses API usage object exposes a per-image or per-modality breakdown alongside the aggregate; needs live probe
imageTokenAccounting.antiDoubleChargeRule: image token cost is computed pre-call by the documented patch formula and added directly into prompt_tokens/input_tokens; do not add a separate client-side estimate on top of the returned usage value

imageModels.pricingUnit: per token, standard input rate (no per-image SKU for analysis)

voice.notes: text/vision model, not a realtime/audio model

imageModels.tokenization: tile-based: base tokens + N x 512px tiles after scale-to-2048 and shortest-side-768px

imageModels.capabilityClass: image generation/editing (accepts image input, primary output is image, not analysis text)

usageAccounting.audioTokenRate: 1 token per 100ms input audio; 1 token per 50ms output audio
usageAccounting.antiDoubleCountRule: audio, text, and image are separate billable token categories, not folded into one aggregate — sum them as distinct line items, do not merge into a single input_tokens bucket
usageAccounting.streamingUsageShape: UNKNOWN — exact usage-event JSON shape (incremental vs session-final, cached-audio breakdown granularity) not confirmed live this session

voiceModels.classification: realtime speech-to-speech translation (dedicated session type, not standard voice-agent lifecycle)
voiceModels.notes: continuous session; no response.create call; no turn-taking lifecycle
controllable latency via delay setting; lower delay = earlier partial text

voiceModels.classification: STT + LLM + TTS pipeline component (file/bounded transcription)

voiceModels.model: UNKNOWN — dedicated TTS model IDs (e.g. tts-1-class names)
voiceModels.verification: UNKNOWN — not re-confirmed live this session; requires a direct fetch of https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech

providers.structuralNote: Google now presents the Interactions API (v1beta/interactions) as the GA recommended surface, distinct from the older generateContent endpoint that the reviewed baseline usage-reference file documents exclusively. Field-level usage-object equivalence between the two surfaces is UNKNOWN and is the top item in the live-probe plan.

imageModels.modelFamily: gemini-3.6-flash / gemini-3.5-flash / gemini-3.5-flash-lite / gemini-3.1-pro-preview / gemini-3.1-flash-lite / gemini-3-flash-preview / gemini-2.5-pro / gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-flash-lite
imageModels.status: STABLE or PREVIEW (see research doc per-model table)
imageModels.apiFamily: Interactions API (GA, recommended) / generateContent (legacy but still documented)
imageInputMethods: inline base64 data (20MB total request cap)
imageModels.rawUrlSupport: UNKNOWN — not confirmed whether a bare external https URL (without Files API mediation) is accepted

imageTokenAccounting.breakdownFieldName: promptTokensDetails[] with modality='IMAGE' (generateContent shape); Interactions-API-equivalent field name UNKNOWN
imageTokenAccounting.antiDoubleChargeRule: the modality breakdown is a non-additive breakdown OF the aggregate; bill only off the aggregate (promptTokenCount / totalTokenCount or Interactions-API equivalent), never add the breakdown on top
imageTokenAccounting.tokenFormula: 258 tokens if both dimensions <=384px; otherwise tiled into 768x768px tiles at 258 tokens/tile
imageTokenAccounting.mediaResolutionParam: media_resolution controls max tokens allocated per image/frame (Gemini 3+)
imageTokenAccounting.verification: DOCUMENTED (generateContent shape) / UNKNOWN (Interactions API field names)

imageModels.pricingUnit: per token, standard input rate for analysis; image is NOT surcharged relative to text on current models (audio is)

imageModels.modelFamily: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2) / gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro) / gemini-2.5-flash-image (Nano Banana) / gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image

gemini-2.5-flash-image.billingUnit: IMAGE (not token-based output for this generation)

voiceModels.model: any standard Gemini model (e.g. gemini-3.6-flash) with audio content block
voiceModels.classification: audio input to text output (not a distinct endpoint, just an input modality)

usageAccounting.audioOutputUsageShape: UNKNOWN — baseline usage-reference file explicitly flags this unconfirmed; not closed in this pass

imageTokenFoldingPattern.openai: folded only for analysis models; separate breakdown existence UNKNOWN

voiceBillingPattern.openai: audio/text/image are separate billable categories per turn
voiceBillingPattern.gemini: audio/text/image folded into one aggregate with a non-additive per-modality breakdown, same pattern as its image handling
